title: 有機中介層製作
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入有機中介層 RDL、回流與機械順應性；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine organic-interposer rdl, returns and mechanical compliance. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。有機中介層不是單一材料或通用製程；公開 CoWoS-R 案例僅示範架構，尺寸與可靠度資料不得外推全部供應商。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Organic interposers are not one material or universal process; public CoWoS-R examples illustrate architecture, not universal geometry or reliability.

stages.title: 架構與層疊
stages.description: 本階段處理架構與層疊：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address architecture and stack-up through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 劃分晶粒與中介層
steps.objective: 建立「劃分晶粒與中介層」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：中介層把高密度晶粒互連轉接到較大尺度封裝，需定義兩端焊墊。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for partition dies and interposer: An interposer translates dense die connections to package scale; both pad interfaces need definition.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。畫出晶粒、RDL、C4 及基板的層次。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Draw die, RDL, C4 and substrate levels. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：畫出晶粒、RDL、C4 及基板的層次。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Draw die, RDL, C4 and substrate levels. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：有機材料柔軟所以沒有熱應力。本步先檢查「劃分晶粒與中介層」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到中介層把高密度晶粒互連轉接到較大尺度封裝，需定義兩端焊墊。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Organic compliance eliminates all thermal stress. First check whether evidence for partition dies and interposer actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: An interposer translates dense die connections to package scale; both pad interfaces need definition.
steps.check: 交付「劃分晶粒與中介層」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for partition dies and interposer, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。畫出晶粒、RDL、C4 及基板的層次。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Draw die, RDL, C4 and substrate levels. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.

quiz.question: 在「分配逃線區域：反證與驗收」中，哪個處理方式或主張有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach or claim is physically justified for allocate escape routing: challenge and acceptance?
options: 選一個晶粒角落完整逃線至中介層邊緣。
有機材料柔軟所以沒有熱應力
RDL 線距夠小就保證高速訊號完整性
optionsEn: Route one die corner fully to the interposer edge.
Organic compliance eliminates all thermal stress
Fine RDL spacing guarantees high-speed integrity
quiz.explanation: 焊墊陣列、過孔與線距共同限制可佈線性。 選一個晶粒角落完整逃線至中介層邊緣。
quiz.explanationEn: Pad arrays, vias and spacing jointly limit routability. Route one die corner fully to the interposer edge.
